text: @local/comsol-agent 是面向 DSH 的 COMSOL Multiphysics 自动化插件，通过注册一组工具并调用独立 Java 桥接进程接入 COMSOL Java API。它支持检查安装与模型、创建轴对称或矩形槽模型、修改参数并运行求解，也能执行参数扫描、查询任务、诊断日志以及评估和导出结果。适合需要从 DSH 管理本地电磁仿真流程的工程人员。使用前需在 Windows 安装 COMSOL 6.2 并具备有效许可，结果保存在本地工作区。

@local/comsol-agent adds COMSOL tools to DSH through a Java bridge. It creates and checks models, edits parameters, runs solves and sweeps, tracks jobs, analyzes results and exports files. For local simulation workflows; requires COMSOL 6.2 on Windows and a valid license.

COMSOL-agent 的模型创建功能：从内置轴对称同轴或矩形槽模板生成模型，可选择直接求解；通过 DSH 工具提交模板、名称和参数。
COMSOL-agent 的参数修改功能：为已有模型设置全局参数并保存为输出模型，输入模型路径与参数映射；输出位置受工作区配置约束。
COMSOL-agent 的参数扫描功能：对给定参数取值组合逐个运行独立任务，可查看状态并支持取消或续跑；扫描规模受配置上限控制。
COMSOL-agent 的结果分析与导出功能：读取全局量、积分、极值及点线数据，并导出 S 参数、表格、线数据或场图。

- 环境检测与真实许可检出
- 2D 轴对称同轴圆锥模型建模、网格和频域求解
- 3D 矩形波导开槽模型、TE10 端口和槽口场评估
- S11、场量积分、最大值/平均值、截线插值
- 4 组参数扫描
- CSV、PNG 导出
- 异步任务、取消、超时和日志诊断

| 测试 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 单元测试 | 9/9 |
| 真实 COMSOL 集成测试 | 1/1（约 154 s） |
| 13 步自测 | 13/13 |

示例模型的 S11 为 `-0.002612 + 0.253224j`，即 `0.2532`、`-11.93 dB`。这只是一个空气填充理想几何的数值结果，不代表结构已经优化。

@local/comsol-agent README · 工作方式：```
DeepSeek Harness
  └─ comsol-agent（Host 插件，Node.js）
       ├─ 工具与参数校验
       ├─ 任务队列、超时、取消、日志

插件不启动服务，也不监听端口。每次求解是一个独立的 COMSOL JVM 进程，默认串行执行，避免占用多个许可席位。COMSOL 安装目录自带的 `java.exe`、`javac.exe` 和 `plugins\*` 就够用，不需要额外 JDK。

工作区默认在 `%USERPROFILE%\comsol-agent-workspace`：

```
comsol-agent-workspace/
  jobs/       任务记录、日志、结果
  models/     新建模型
  runs/       运行输出、参数修改输出

@local/comsol-agent README · 环境要求：- Windows 10/11 x64
- COMSOL Multiphysics 6.2，安装目录下存在 `bin\win64\comsolbatch.exe`、`java\win64\jre\bin\java.exe`、`javac.exe`、`plugins\com.comsol.api_*.jar`
- 可用的 COMSOL 许可

MATLAB 和 LiveLink 只做安装检测，没有验证许可，也没有调用接口。

@local/comsol-agent README · 安装：插件目录放在本机任意位置，然后通过 Harness 的插件管理器安装：

```text
plugin_manager(
  action="install_bundle",
  target="D:\\path\\to\\comsol-agent"
)

成功时返回 `application: "applied"`，工具列表里会出现 11 个 `comsol_*` 工具。

修改 JS 代码后，关闭再启用插件即可重新加载：

```text
plugin_manager(action="set_plugin", target="include:comsol-agent", enabled=false)
plugin_manager(action="set_plugin", target="include:comsol-agent", enabled=true)
```

只改 `java/ComsolBridge.java` 时不用重载插件，下次调用会根据源文件时间戳重新编译。

@local/comsol-agent README · 配置：配置写在 bundle 行的 `config` 中，全部可选。

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: comsol-agent
      name: '@local/comsol-agent'
      config:

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `workspaceRoot` | `%USERPROFILE%\comsol-agent-workspace` | 输出根目录 |
| `comsolHome` | 自动探测 | 指向 `...\Multiphysics` |
| `allowedRoots` | 工作区 | 允许写出的额外目录 |
| `maxConcurrentJobs` | `1` | 同时运行的 COMSOL 进程数 |
| `maxSweepCombinations` | `12` | 未确认时允许的最大扫描组数 |
| `defaultTimeoutSec` | `600` | 默认超时 |
| `javaHeap` | `-Xmx2g` | COMSOL JVM 堆参数 |
@local/comsol-agent README · 配置：自动探测会检查 `COMSOL_HOME`、各盘根目录和 `Program Files` 下的 `COMSOL*` 目录，只有同时存在批处理程序和 `plugins` 才会采用。

@local/comsol-agent README · 建模模板：`coaxial_conical_gap` 是一个 2D 轴对称空气域，顶点按逆时针排列（mm）：

```
(r_in, 0) → (r_out, 0) → (r_out, z_feed) → (r_tip_out, z_tip)
         → (r_tip_in, z_tip) → (r_in, z_feed)
```

- 底边是同轴 TEM 端口，`PortName=1`，默认参考阻抗 50 Ω，激励功率 `P_in`
- 顶边是散射边界
- 其余边界默认 PEC
- 材料是空气（`epsr=1, mur=1, sigma=0`）
- 研究类型是频域，`plist=freq`

模板只对空气区域建模，金属壁用 PEC 边界表示，没有实体金属域；不包含等离子体、气体流动和传热。这些限制会在工具返回的 `modelingAssumptions` 里列出。

`rf_coax_air` 是同样的设置，几何换成一段均匀同轴空气段，适合做最小连通性测试。

@local/comsol-agent README · 结果与单位：- 模板几何长度单位是 mm。
- `S11` 返回实部和虚部，`|S11| = hypot(real, imag)`，`dB = 20 log10(|S11|)`。
- 2D 轴对称的体积分使用 `IntSurface + intvolume=on`，单位可能是 `V*m^2`，不是 `V`。
- 边界面分使用 `IntLine + intsurface=on`。
- 评估结果的单位以 COMSOL 返回的 `unit` 为准。
- `uniformity=true` 时使用 `U = 1 - (max - min) / (max + min)`，这是显式公式，不是 COMSOL 标准量。

@local/comsol-agent README · 文件与许可：所有输出默认限制在工作区内。`set_parameters`、`run_model`、`export_results`、`parameter_sweep` 遇到已存在的目标文件会报 `OUTPUT_EXISTS`，需要显式 `overwrite=true` 才会替换。原始模型不会被覆盖。

外部程序使用参数数组启动，不拼接 shell 字符串；可执行文件限定为 COMSOL 目录下的固定程序；插件不上传模型、数据或日志。

@local/comsol-agent README · 限制：- 等离子体、气体流动、传热没有实现。缺少气体种类、压力、电子密度、碰撞频率等数据时不会自动生成这类模型。
- `create_model` 目前有两个 2D 轴对称模板和一个 3D 矩形波导开槽模板；任意几何和通用 3D 端口还没有接口。
- 参数扫描采用逐组独立运行，不是 COMSOL 原生 Parametric 研究步。这样做可以保留每组日志、失败隔离和断点续跑，代价是每组都要启动一次 COMSOL。
- S 参数 CSV 目前用 `solution_index` 标识解，多频点研究还没有自动频率列。
- MATLAB/LiveLink 只做了存在性检测，没有验证许可或调用。
- 当前实现针对 COMSOL 6.2 验证；其他版本可能需要调整 API 属性名。
- 本地化标签在不同启动上下文中可能乱码，工具会丢弃损坏标签，以 `tag/type/identifier` 为准。

@local/comsol-agent README · How it works：```
DeepSeek Harness
  └─ comsol-agent (host plugin, Node.js)
       ├─ tool registration and argument validation
       ├─ job queue, timeouts, cancellation, logs

There is no server and no listening port. Each solve runs in a separate COMSOL JVM process. Jobs run one at a time by default so a sweep does not consume several license seats. The `java.exe`, `javac.exe` and `plugins\*` directories shipped with COMSOL are sufficient; no external JDK is required.

@local/comsol-agent README · How it works：The default workspace is `%USERPROFILE%\comsol-agent-workspace`:

```
comsol-agent-workspace/
  jobs/       job records, logs and results
  models/     newly created models
  runs/       run output and parameter-edit output

@local/comsol-agent README · Requirements：- Windows 10/11 x64
- COMSOL Multiphysics 6.2, with `bin\win64\comsolbatch.exe`, `java\win64\jre\bin\java.exe`, `javac.exe` and `plugins\com.comsol.api_*.jar`
- A working COMSOL license

MATLAB and LiveLink are only checked for installed files. Their licenses and APIs are not verified or used.

)

A successful install returns `application: "applied"`, and 11 `comsol_*` tools appear in the tool list.

After editing JavaScript, disable and re-enable the plugin:

```

Editing `java/ComsolBridge.java` does not require a reload. The next tool call recompiles it when the source timestamp is newer.

@local/comsol-agent README · Quick example：For an existing model, the usual order is `validate_model` → inspect `physics/studies/parameters` → `run_model` if there is no solution → `evaluate_results` → `export_results`.

@local/comsol-agent README · Model templates：`coaxial_conical_gap` is a 2D axisymmetric air domain with these vertices in millimetres:

```
(r_in, 0) → (r_out, 0) → (r_out, z_feed) → (r_tip_out, z_tip)
         → (r_tip_in, z_tip) → (r_in, z_feed)
```

- Bottom edge: coaxial TEM port, `PortName=1`, default 50 Ω reference, `P_in` excitation
- Top edge: scattering boundary
- Other boundaries: default PEC
- Material: air (`epsr=1`, `mur=1`, `sigma=0`)
- Study: frequency domain, `plist=freq`

@local/comsol-agent README · Model templates：Only the air region is modelled. Metal walls are PEC boundaries, not solid domains. The template contains no plasma, gas flow or heat transfer. These assumptions are returned in `modelingAssumptions`.

`rf_coax_air` uses the same setup with a uniform coaxial air section, which is useful for a minimal connectivity test.

@local/comsol-agent README · Model templates：`rectangular_slot_launcher` is a 3D cold-EM template: a WR-340 waveguide, a longitudinal slot in the broad wall, a fused-silica window and an outer air box. The default waveguide is 200 mm long, the slot is 150 × 12 mm, the slot centre is 20 mm from the broad-wall centreline, and the window is 4 mm thick with `epsr=3.8`. Both ends are rectangular TE10 ports; the outer box uses scattering boundaries to approximate open half-space. An optional metal ridge (`ridge_h`) under the slot reduces the gap and concentrates the field.

@local/comsol-agent README · Model templates：Main parameters: `a`, `b`, `L`, `slot_l`, `slot_w`, `slot_offset`, `t_m`, `t_q`, `quartz_w`, `quartz_l`, `quartz_er`, `outer_h`, `outer_x`, `margin`, `ridge_h`, `ridge_w`, `ridge_l`. The slot must be offset from the broad-wall centreline; a centred longitudinal slot couples very weakly to the TE10 surface current, which shows up as S21 near 0 dB and a weak slot field.

A 150 mm line-source design study and first cold-EM results are in [宽幅微波等离子体源设计](docs/宽幅微波等离子体源设计.md) (Chinese).

@local/comsol-agent README · Results and units：- Template geometry uses millimetres.
- `S11` is returned as real and imaginary parts. `|S11| = hypot(real, imag)` and `dB = 20 log10(|S11|)`.
- A 2D axisymmetric volume integral uses `IntSurface` with `intvolume=on`; its unit may be `V*m^2`, not `V`.
- A boundary integral uses `IntLine` with `intsurface=on`.
- Units in evaluation results come from COMSOL's `unit` field.
- `uniformity=true` uses the explicit formula `U = 1 - (max - min) / (max + min)`. It is not a built-in COMSOL quantity.

@local/comsol-agent README · Files and output protection：Outputs are restricted to the workspace. `set_parameters`, `run_model`, `export_results` and `parameter_sweep` return `OUTPUT_EXISTS` when a target file already exists; pass `overwrite=true` to replace it. Input models are never overwritten.

External programs are started with argument arrays, not shell strings. Executables are limited to fixed programs under the COMSOL installation. The plugin does not upload models, data or logs.

@local/comsol-agent README · Limitations：- Plasma, gas flow and heat transfer are not implemented. The plugin will not generate such models without gas species, pressure, electron density, collision frequency and similar data.
- `create_model` has two 2D axisymmetric templates and one 3D rectangular-slot template. Arbitrary geometry and generic 3D port setups do not have an interface yet.
- Parameter sweeps run one independent COMSOL process per case instead of a native Parametric study step. This keeps per-case logs, failure isolation and resume support, at the cost of one COMSOL startup per case.
- S-parameter CSV files use `solution_index`; multi-frequency studies do not yet get an automatic frequency column.
- MATLAB/LiveLink are checked for installed files only. Their licenses and APIs are not verified or called.
- The current implementation is verified against COMSOL 6.2. Other versions may need different API property names.
- Localized labels can be garbled depending on the launch context. Damaged labels are dropped; use `tag`, `type` and `identifier` instead.
